name: Andolor: Three Moons
description: An Aardwolf-inspired explorer atlas: moonlit slate and gold, emerald groves, iridescent seas, Alagh-inspired copper dunes, Gelidus-inspired frost, and the violet twilight of Abend. 114 original SVG terrain designs rendered at 128 pixels with matching material edges. Version 1.0.0.
